sql:
WITH
sales AS
(
    SELECT
        DateKey,
        ProductKey,
        SalesAmount
    FROM retail.FactSales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        DateKey,
        ProductKey,
        SalesAmount
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
),
product_intro AS
(
    SELECT
        p.ProductKey,
        toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) AS ProductSubcategoryKey,
        min(s.DateKey) AS intro_date
    FROM retail.DimProduct AS p
    INNER JOIN sales AS s
        ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    WHERE p.ProductSubcategoryKey IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        p.ProductKey,
        ProductSubcategoryKey
),
intro_events AS
(
    SELECT
        ProductSubcategoryKey,
        ProductKey AS new_product_key,
        intro_date AS event_date
    FROM product_intro
),
existing_product_window_sales AS
(
    SELECT
        e.ProductSubcategoryKey,
        e.new_product_key,
        e.event_date,
        sumIf(s.SalesAmount, s.DateKey >= addDays(e.event_date, -30) AND s.DateKey < e.event_date) AS existing_sales_30d_before,
        sumIf(s.SalesAmount, s.DateKey >= e.event_date AND s.DateKey < addDays(e.event_date, 30)) AS existing_sales_30d_after
    FROM intro_events AS e
    INNER JOIN product_intro AS pi
        ON pi.ProductSubcategoryKey = e.ProductSubcategoryKey
       AND pi.intro_date < e.event_date
    INNER JOIN sales AS s
        ON s.ProductKey = pi.ProductKey
       AND s.DateKey >= addDays(e.event_date, -30)
       AND s.DateKey < addDays(e.event_date, 30)
    GROUP BY
        e.ProductSubcategoryKey,
        e.new_product_key,
        e.event_date
)
SELECT
    dps.ProductSubcategoryName AS product_subcategory,
    count() AS new_product_introductions_analyzed,
    round(avg(existing_sales_30d_before), 2) AS avg_existing_sales_30d_before,
    round(avg(existing_sales_30d_after), 2) AS avg_existing_sales_30d_after,
    round(avg(existing_sales_30d_after - existing_sales_30d_before), 2) AS avg_sales_delta,
    round(
        100.0 * (avg(existing_sales_30d_after) - avg(existing_sales_30d_before)) / nullIf(avg(existing_sales_30d_before), 0),
        2
    ) AS avg_pct_change_existing_sales,
    multiIf(
        avg(existing_sales_30d_after) > avg(existing_sales_30d_before), 'Increase',
        avg(existing_sales_30d_after) < avg(existing_sales_30d_before), 'Decrease',
        'No Change'
    ) AS impact_direction
FROM existing_product_window_sales AS w
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS dps
    ON dps.ProductSubcategoryKey = w.ProductSubcategoryKey
GROUP BY dps.ProductSubcategoryName
ORDER BY avg_pct_change_existing_sales DESC, product_subcategory;
